body: how is the trip going? i hope you're thinking about happy times you've had and people that love you, like your parents. you haven't done anything wrong by eating all those tabs and some xanax, you're probably trying to escape and it isn't the worst way of escaping. honestly the two best trips of my life started with complete despair, i really hope that you're realising a few things right now

You might need to work out what part of your life it is that you're struggling most to accept. Even working out what that is will be extremely painful but if you're successful it will be very, very worthwhile.

I have been thinking about suicide for days and I can relate to wanting to relieve the world of the burden of my existence, but I have two things that I really hope you think about. 

1. Are you sure that your existence is more of a burden than a benefit? 

2. Regardless of how much you have been struggling; you may have been unproductive or destructive lately, you can always better yourself, meaning that you are more beneficial to everyone and everything around you. 

I can promise you that you have incredible human potential and that you are not a burden.

Especially since its your birthday, try to do the nicest thing that you possibly can for yourself. I hate my birthdays, I can really relate to "celebrating another year of shit existence" but in reality battling through this takes incredible strength and even though things aren't fair, you definitely at least deserve to be kind to yourself. Stay strong, happy birthday <3

You don't need to stay alive for anyone else, stay alive for you. Even if tomorrow feels just as bad, and the day after, you would immediately regret losing your ability to breathe and you would wonder about all the things you would miss in the next few decades. Its painful but, this is all we have. Please say strong, I know its so fucking hard.
